issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

dataAssetAccessToken.description: The access token to the desired resource

dataAssetResource.description:
The App Id URl of the target Azure service.  In this case
it is the Azure Data Catalog URI.

dataAssetAuthCode.description: Azure data asset API authorization code

redirectUri.description: The redirect_uri of the app.  The value is rn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob

expiresOn.description:
The time when the access token expires. The date is represented as the number of
seconds from 1970-01-01T0:0:0Z UTC until the expiration time.
This value is used to determine the lifetime of cached tokens.

title:
